subject: literature
passage: Last winter, Rune ______ his grandfather bake flatbread in the old stone oven behind the house for the first time. He watched the thin rounds of dough puff and brown within seconds, and by the end of the afternoon he could roll them out almost as evenly as his grandfather did.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The sentence describes something that happened at a stated past time, "Last winter," and the rest of the passage uses past-tense verbs ("watched," "could roll," "did"). So the simple past "helped" is needed.
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Helping" is not a finite verb, so the sentence would have no main verb.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The future "will help" does not fit an event that already happened last winter.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The present tense "helps" does not fit an event placed in the past by "Last winter."
explanation.D: Correct. The simple past "helped" matches "Last winter" and the other past-tense verbs.
